policy: Frozen before the implementation (issue #110). R13 and S2 are the targets; X cases are extra positives and N cases negatives (observation only), all counted apart. Each edit runs the edit, then the edit back from the saved PDF alone; candidates are listed, a save without approving them must be refused, and the listed ones are approved; an approval is never carried from one step to the next. Saved, practical (existing audit and approved-change audit side by side, quality, structure, links), re-edit, restore and refusal are recorded apart. A lengthened paragraph need not be pixel-identical; search that is not verified is no practical success; a fixture is never a real-PDF success. No PDF, string, coordinate or page enters the engine.
procedure: freeze: the observation of the B2 at the freeze (rows, groups, paragraph, chain candidates)
run old (main) and new: edit; reopen the saved PDF alone (raw groups, the paragraph of the new text, geometry); edit back; compare with the source
negative: the groups near the place, by old and new
